items.name: game-art-reference-packs
items.title: Game Art Reference Packs
items.description: Creates and validates Final Stand concept turnarounds and deterministic four-view upload packs with source lineage. Use when preparing or correcting front, left, back and right references for a unit or a Meshy generation request; provider transactions belong to meshy-asset-production.

items.name: meshy-asset-production
items.title: Meshy Asset Production
items.description: Runs Final Stand Meshy geometry and texture production with governed reference packs, candidate review, credit accounting and immutable exports. Use when generating, retrying, texturing or recovering a Meshy unit task; humanoid rigging and motion selection belong to humanoid-animation.

items.name: game-model-cleanup
items.title: Game Model Cleanup
items.description: Converts Final Stand provider meshes into budgeted, textured and verifiable game-model candidates using the existing Blender tooling. Use when repairing geometry, reducing polygons, separating equipment, correcting materials, normalizing transforms or preparing accepted exports; animation authoring uses the existing animation skills.

items.name: unity-asset-integration
items.title: Unity Asset Integration
items.description: Installs and verifies Final Stand 3D model packages or animation updates through the repository's Unity importers, presentation profiles and prefab installers. Use when deploying an accepted model, wiring its materials or presentation, validating imported clips, or checking that an installed unit appears correctly in gameplay.

items.name: creature-animation
items.title: Creature Animation
items.description: Author, gate, preview and install production animation sets for Final Stand creatures (quadrupeds, arthropods, flyers, hybrids) using the Plan 009 pipeline in tools/3d/animation_quality/creatures. Use when adding a creature to the roster, re-authoring a creature's Idle/Locomotion/BasicAttack/Hit/Death/Cast clips, fixing a rejected animation, running the reimport gates or Unity install, or when the user mentions creature animation, bites, deaths, gaits, reels, Plan 009 or the animal roster.

items.name: humanoid-animation
items.title: Humanoid Animation
items.description: Produce production animation sets for Final Stand humanoid heroes and enemies from Meshy's humanoid rig and preset motion library (Plan 011 route), then package, gate, preview and install them. Use when animating a humanoid subject (Thorgrim, Sylra, Ignis, Seraphine, Malachar, Rhazgar, skeletons, necromancer, ogres, trolls, demon vanguard, bone colossus), choosing Meshy presets for Idle/Locomotion/BasicAttack/Cast/Hit/Death, rigging a biped on Meshy, or when the user mentions humanoid animation, Mixamo, preset motions, Plan 011 or the Malachar pilot.

items.name: rig-it
items.title: Rig It
items.description: Contract-driven game character rigging and animation: scaffold rigs for creatures, Mixamo-skeleton packaging for bipeds, gates on a fresh reimport, reels, Unity Humanoid/Generic export. Blender 4.5 headless scripts included. Installs to .claude/skills/rig-it/ in the target project.

items.name: orc-me
items.title: Orc Me
items.description: Orc voice mode — blunt, decisive, no-hedging answers with full technical accuracy. Installs to .claude/skills/orc-me/SKILL.md in the target project.

items.name: war-boss-review
items.title: War-Boss Review
items.description: Blunt orc code review — ranks findings KILL IT / WEAK / WAAAGH-WORTHY and forces a ship/hold verdict. Installs to .claude/skills/war-boss-review/SKILL.md in the target project.

items.name: cut-it
items.title: Cut It
items.description: Cut an existing plan into ordered, self-contained slices (execution phases) sized for an AI agent to run one at a time. Installs to .claude/skills/cut-it/SKILL.md in the target project.

items.name: auto-grill
items.title: Auto Grill
items.description: Self-driving grill-me: interrogates a plan one question at a time, offers three answers (A/B/C) with one Recommended, and auto-answers with the recommended option until the plan is resolved. Installs to .claude/skills/auto-grill/SKILL.md in the target project.

items.name: shadscan-pre-commit
items.title: Shadscan Pre-commit
items.description: Give AI agents a Shadscan baseline and pre-commit audit protocol without changing project dependencies, scripts, or Git configuration.

items.name: intro-video
items.title: Intro Video
items.description: Remotion intro/reel/brand-film skill with remocn and ASR-timed captions. Installs to .claude/skills/intro-video/ in the target project.

items.name: short-format-video
items.title: Short Format Video
items.description: Write TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts scripts as one package: spoken script plus an editor-ready beat-by-beat shot list (camera, captions, graphics, B-roll, cuts), following the Hook, bridge, Value, CTA arc with four titles, description, X post and tags. Installs to .claude/skills/short-format-video/SKILL.md in the target project.

items.name: github-to-origin
items.title: GitHub to Origin
items.description: Move a repo from GitHub to Cursor Origin hosting, including repointing Vercel so production keeps deploying. Installs to .claude/skills/github-to-origin/SKILL.md in the target project.

items.name: grond
items.title: GROND
items.description: One word, GROND, and the agent stages everything, commits it, gets it onto the default branch, pushes, and reports the result in orc voice. Installs to .claude/skills/grond/SKILL.md in the target project.

items.name: living-backdrop
items.title: Living Backdrop
items.description: Turn one still image into a living web backdrop: depth parallax, a breathing subject, and ambient wind, clouds, light and dust in one WebGL shader with a poster fallback. Asset pipeline and three.js component included. Installs to .claude/skills/living-backdrop/ in the target project.

items.name: voice-cast
items.title: Voice Cast
items.description: Voice every line of a point-and-click adventure with ElevenLabs: extract lines by static Dialogue Manager ID, diff against a lock, post masters to -18 LUFS QOA, and write the envelopes that drive a mouthless hero. Generation is the designed process, marked unproven. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/voice-cast/.

items.name: ship-check
items.title: Ship Check
items.description: Prove a point-and-click adventure change in the builds people play: headless import, GUT and lint, scripted QA in the exported desktop app and in Chrome, the real pack file list, per-room budgets, reels, evidence in docs/qa and Vercel deploys. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/ship-check/.

items.name: art-requests
items.title: Art Requests
items.description: Generate every game image through a request file: GPT-6.1 Sol through Codex or GPT Image through the Vercel AI Gateway, immutable raws, receipts, a spend ledger, per-plan budgets with an 80% stop, and a review table that records which variant won and why. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/art-requests/.

items.name: look-gate
items.title: Look Gate
items.description: Set a point-and-click game's look before volume art: the style bible, composition rules for playable rooms, shared prompt preambles, an engine A/B, the first style key and landmark crops, the hero's model sheet, and one room proven in the engine with the operator's sign-off. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/look-gate/.

items.name: paint-room
items.title: Paint Room
items.description: Turn an atlas entry into a playable point-and-click room: Sol paints the present, the past is an edit of it, an alignment gate checks the pair, and a traced room.json builds the art and the Godot scene through adv-art room and new_room.gd. Close-ups, item icons, props and clean plates included. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/paint-room/.

items.name: story-track
items.title: Story Track
items.description: Write a point-and-click adventure's story and puzzles so they can be built and tested: three drafted cores, a signed bible, cast and room atlas, a Mermaid puzzle chart per part before any art, Dialogue Manager scripts with static line IDs and voice direction, hint goals, journal pages and a playthrough that GUT and QA both run. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/story-track/.

items.name: skinned-npc
items.title: Skinned NPC
items.description: Add a talking side character to a point-and-click game as one painting skinned to a few bones: Sol paints the NPC once on transparency, npc.json places the bones and feet, adv-art npc trims and grades it, new_npc.gd meshes and skins it to a Skeleton2D, and RigBody plays idle, voice-driven talk and keyed one-shots written as data. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/skinned-npc/.

items.name: painted-hero
items.title: Painted Hero
items.description: Design and animate a point-and-click game's main character as hand-painted 2D frames: a Blender mannequin rig supplies every pose, Sol paints the hero over 4x2 pose-guide sheets, and adv-art cuts, registers and packs the frames with the rig's anchors, events and ground speed. Pose rig script included. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/painted-hero/.

items.name: memory-reveals
items.title: Memory Reveals
items.description: Add two-state places and cinematics to a point-and-click game: an aligned past carried in the same room, visions, playable memories, memory vistas, zoom-out discovery reveals built from 3:1 rings, a cutscene runner whose skip leaves the world as a watched run would, letterbox, journal rewatching and Reduce camera motion. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/memory-reveals/.

items.name: new-adventure
items.title: New Adventure
items.description: Set up a mouse-only, fully voiced point-and-click adventure in Godot 4.7.2 from a working template: adventure core with verb coin, inventory, dialogue, saves, hints, journal and cutscenes; scaffolds; image, art and voice tools; GUT tests, lint, scripted QA, desktop and web builds; a greybox sample that plays end to end. Part of the point-and-click-adventure collection. Installs to ~/.claude/skills/new-adventure/.
